text:
Sam (Growth): Quick pitch 16-min microdemo + 24-min guided lab + 3 short posts + a 3-arm credit experiment. Calling it 'Microdemo Circuit'. Goal: test which credit timing drives the best 7-day activation.
Irene (Design): Love the name. Two visual hooks: "Microdemo: Build fast" (developer POV) and "Microdemo: Economize inference" (finance POV). I can mock both with a compact benchmark card.
Vik (Product): Format: 12m live build, 18m hands-on lab, 6m deploy/QA. Deliverable: working endpoint + lightweight prompt bundle (3 persona-ready templates).
Corey (Eng): Routing and experiment design: we'll randomize users into three arms at signup: IMMEDIATE (credits on signup), DELAY_48H (credits after 48h), and USAGE_GATED (credits unlocked after 500 tokens). Tag cohort=microdemo-circuit. Emit lead_event when 7d_tokens >= 800.
lead-bot: Signup page live -> 23 regs in first 70m, CTR 3.1% :sparkles:
Sam (Growth): Draft social copy; please edit:
```
Short A: "Ship an LLM feature in minutes. Join Microdemo Circuit + claim starter credits: https://redwood.ai/microdemo"
Short B: "Measure cost + latency in a live lab. Microdemo Circuit: build, deploy, and compare. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/microdemo"
Long: "Microdemo Circuit is a hands-on session for engineers: build a small LLM feature, deploy it, and get a starter prompt bundle. Attendees enter a credit experiment to help us learn what drives activation. Limited seats."
```
Irene (Design): A is crisp for X, B reads better on LinkedIn. I'll produce hero gifs + a benchmark mini-card showing per-token cost and 95p latency vs our baseline. Need 95p numbers for the default small model, @Corey can you drop them?
Corey (Eng): Will pull 50/95/99 pctl latency and per-token cost. Implementation note for signup payload: include credit_arm field with values IMMEDIATE|DELAY_48H|USAGE_GATED. sample payload as string: '{"cohort":"microdemo-circuit","credit_arm":"IMMEDIATE|DELAY_48H|USAGE_GATED"}' (this is just the payload format). I'll wire the randomizer and the event hooks.
Sam (Growth): Routing rules proposal (lightweight):
```json
{ "source": "microdemo_form", "tags": ["cohort:microdemo-circuit","launch:microdemo"], "route_to": "growth-sales", "route_if": {"7d_tokens": ">=800"}, "fallback": "auto-nurture" }
```
Vik (Product): Add a queue-safeguard: if growth-sales backlog > 25 leads, route to a high-intent nurture sequence + invite to office hours.
Sam (Growth): Hypotheses: IMMEDIATE increases attendance; DELAY_48H increases post-attendance curiosity; USAGE_GATED selects for intent and will produce higher activation rate per credit cost. Metrics: reg->attend, attend->7d_tokens, activation rate (>800 tokens in 7d), cost-per-activated-user. Primary KPI = % registrants reaching 800 tokens in 7d.
Irene (Design): ETA for assets? I can deliver two hero GIFs + benchmark card by tomorrow noon.
Corey (Eng): I'll provision the randomization flag, wire analytics events (registration, attendance, credit_grant, 7d_token_count), and post infra numbers by EOD.
Vik (Product): I'll finalize agenda and assemble the 3-template prompt bundle (chatbot, code-assistant, summarizer).
lead-bot: Early ad sample -> creative A CTR 4.0%, creative B CTR 2.9% in initial run.
Sam (Growth): Action items: Irene (creative assets), Vik (agenda & prompts), Corey (routing + infra numbers), Sam (ads + tracking). Schedule dry run 24h before. Thanks team :rocket:
